title: Football Club Management & European Financial Fair Play (FFP) Regulations
description: High-register management English module analyzing UEFA Financial Sustainability Regulations (FSR), player amortization, and commercial broadcasting rights.
learning_objectives: Master sports finance terminology (transfer fee amortization, PSR thresholds, allowable losses, sell-on clauses)
Apply formal subjunctive and counterfactual conditionals in regulatory sports governance
Demonstrate fluency when debating commercial sponsorship compliance and financial penalties

questions.prompt: _____ the football club not amortized the record transfer fee across a long-term contract, they would have breached domestic spending caps.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had the football club not amortized...' expresses a past counterfactual without 'if'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have breached'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu: 'Had the club not amortized...' = 'Kdyby klub nerozpočítal...'. Do podmínky nepatří 'if' ani 'would'.

questions.prompt: Rarely _____ an independent regulatory commission overturn severe points deductions imposed for inflated commercial sponsorships.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Rarely' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Present Simple auxiliary 'does': 'Rarely does an independent commission overturn...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'is' cannot serve as auxiliary for base verb 'overturn'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will' changes the sentence to predictive future rather than habitual truth.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Rarely' na začátku věty vyžaduje inverzi pomocného slovesa 'does' a podmětu: 'Rarely does a commission overturn...'.

questions.prompt: If the ownership group had diversified commercial merchandising revenue three years ago, the balance sheet _____ red ink today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had diversified') with present ongoing result ('today') takes 'would not be showing'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have shown' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors the result to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not show' is First Conditional, incompatible with past counterfactual condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Simple present indicative 'does not show' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál: minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If they had diversified [minulost], it would not be showing [dnes]'.

questions.prompt: UEFA Financial Sustainability Regulations mandate that every participating club _____ an acceptable squad cost ratio under 70%.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires base form 'demonstrate' regardless of 3rd person singular subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'demonstrates' with 3rd person -s violates mandative subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will demonstrate' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech nařízení (mandate that every club demonstrate): sloveso zůstává v základním tvaru bez -s.

questions.prompt: _____ substantial operational deficits on player wages, the sporting director was compelled to sanction emergency player sales.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having sustained' correctly expresses prior causal damage leading to subsequent forced sales.
explanations.wrong_A: Base verb 'Sustain' cannot function as introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Sustained' without auxiliary is passive, but the club actively sustained the deficits.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Being sustained' expresses continuous passive present, not prior completion.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having sustained = poté, co utrpěl...) vyjadřuje příčinu a děj, který předcházel hlavní větě.

questions.prompt: _____ unprecedented television broadcasting income, mid-table clubs find it difficult to compete with sovereign wealth funds.

explanations.correct: 'Notwithstanding' is a formal preposition followed by a noun phrase ('unprecedented television broadcasting income').
explanations.wrong_A: 'Although' is a conjunction and must be followed by a full finite clause.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Even though' requires a full clause with subject and verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Notwithstanding' (navzdory / bez ohledu na) se pojí s podstatným jménem, zatímco spojky jako 'Although' a 'Even though' vyžadují celou větu.

questions.prompt: The newly recruited forward's contract is confirmed _____ an automatic 15% future sell-on clause payable to his academy club.

explanations.correct: Perfect active infinitive 'to have incorporated' correctly attributes past contractual drafting to the signed agreement.
explanations.wrong_A: Present infinitive 'to incorporate' implies future or ongoing inclusion rather than signed legal status.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'incorporating' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'is confirmed'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'to be incorporating' is continuous and non-standard here.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'is confirmed to have incorporated' (je potvrzeno, že obsahovala) vyjadřuje minulý děj pomocí minulého infinitivu.

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ international sports tribunals reduced point deductions without compelling mitigating forensic financial evidence.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Seldom' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Present Perfect: 'have international sports tribunals reduced...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'did' would require base verb 'reduce', not past participle 'reduced'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'were' would form an ungrammatical passive construction.
explanations.wrong_D: 'had' is past perfect, inappropriate for general legal precedent.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Seldom' na začátku věty vyžaduje přísnou inverzi: 'Seldom have tribunals reduced...'.

questions.prompt: With a reported wage-to-turnover ratio exceeding 110%, the distressed club _____ within statutory financial fair play caps.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot possibly be operating' expresses conclusive deduction of impossibility based on financial statements.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must not' expresses prohibition or negative expectation.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření naprosté nemožnosti (v žádném případě nemůže fungovat v mezích limitů): 'cannot possibly be operating'.

questions.prompt: The league established strict capital expenditure guidelines, in compliance with _____ all stadium renovations must be pre-funded.

explanations.correct: Prepositional relative phrase 'in compliance with which' takes 'which' when modifying regulatory guidelines.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách v rozvitých vztažných větách se pro předpisy a pravidla používá výhradně 'which': 'in compliance with which' (v souladu s nimiž).
